name: Performance Schema 复制监控表
description: Performance Schema 提供了一组完整的复制监控表，取代了传统的 SHOW SLAVE STATUS。这些表按职责分离：connection_status 监控 IO 线程、applier_status 监控 SQL/Worker 线程、applier_status_by_worker 监控各并行 Worker。支持多通道监控（Multi-Source、Group Replication）。是构建复制健康监控的基础。

signals.desc: 各 Worker 线程状态和进度

conditions.desc: 定期或按需检查复制健康状态

skip_when.desc: 实例未配置复制（不是从库）

root_causes.name: IO 线程断开
root_causes.desc: replication_connection_status.SERVICE_STATE != ON，IO 线程停止接收 binlog。原因：主库不可达、binlog 已 purge、复制用户问题。

root_causes.name: SQL/Worker 线程报错停止
root_causes.desc: replication_applier_status_by_worker 中某个 Worker 有 LAST_ERROR_NUMBER > 0，SQL 线程因 apply 错误停止。

root_causes.name: 复制延迟持续增大
root_causes.desc: 通过 APPLYING_TRANSACTION_ORIGINAL_COMMIT_TIMESTAMP 与当前时间的差值计算延迟，比 Seconds_Behind_Source 更精确。

root_causes.name: Group Replication 通道异常
root_causes.desc: group_replication_applier 或 group_replication_recovery 通道状态异常。

step1_connection_status.desc: IO 线程状态（所有通道）
step1_connection_status.sql: SELECT CHANNEL_NAME, SERVICE_STATE, SOURCE_UUID, LAST_HEARTBEAT_TIMESTAMP, LAST_ERROR_NUMBER, LAST_ERROR_MESSAGE, RECEIVED_TRANSACTION_SET FROM performance_schema.replication_connection_status

step2_applier_status.sql: SELECT CHANNEL_NAME, SERVICE_STATE, REMAINING_DELAY, LAST_ERROR_NUMBER, LAST_ERROR_MESSAGE FROM performance_schema.replication_applier_status

step3_worker_status.desc: 各 Worker 线程详细状态
step3_worker_status.sql: SELECT CHANNEL_NAME, WORKER_ID, SERVICE_STATE, LAST_APPLIED_TRANSACTION, LAST_APPLIED_TRANSACTION_END_APPLY_TIMESTAMP, APPLYING_TRANSACTION, APPLYING_TRANSACTION_ORIGINAL_COMMIT_TIMESTAMP, LAST_ERROR_NUMBER, LAST_ERROR_MESSAGE FROM performance_schema.replication_applier_status_by_worker ORDER BY CHANNEL_NAME, WORKER_ID

step4_precise_lag.sql: SELECT CHANNEL_NAME, TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, APPLYING_TRANSACTION_ORIGINAL_COMMIT_TIMESTAMP, NOW()) AS precise_lag_sec, LAST_APPLIED_TRANSACTION_END_APPLY_TIMESTAMP, APPLYING_TRANSACTION_ORIGINAL_COMMIT_TIMESTAMP FROM performance_schema.replication_applier_status_by_worker WHERE APPLYING_TRANSACTION != '' AND CHANNEL_NAME = '' LIMIT 1

step5_applier_config.desc: 复制配置（延迟、并行度等）

step6_connection_config.sql: SELECT CHANNEL_NAME, HOST, PORT, USER, AUTO_POSITION, HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL FROM performance_schema.replication_connection_configuration

real_world_examples.scenario: 从 SHOW SLAVE STATUS 迁移到 P_S 表实现精确延迟监控
real_world_examples.symptoms: Seconds_Behind_Master 在高并发时跳变，不够准确。需要更精确的延迟计算
real_world_examples.root_cause: Seconds_Behind_Master 计算逻辑有缺陷：IO 线程断开时归零、大事务期间不更新
real_world_examples.resolution: 改用 replication_applier_status_by_worker 的 APPLYING_TRANSACTION_ORIGINAL_COMMIT_TIMESTAMP 计算延迟
real_world_examples.result: 延迟监控精度从秒级提升到亚秒级，告警准确率提升 90%
